newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Oce had four pct H1 organic sales growth.
newsitem.headline: Oce had four pct H1 organic sales growth.

text.p: Photocopier maker Oce NV said on Friday its organic turnover growth was four percent in the first half of 1996/97.

Total group sales rose by 40 percent to 2.52 billion guilders, but previous takeovers raised sales by some 29 percent and exchange rate changes had a favourable effect of seven percent, the company said.

Oce's first-half net profit grew by 50 percent to 103.1 percent, in line with previous forecasts that this year's profit rise in percentage terms would outstrip sales growth. It did not give a full-year forecast in today's first-half statement.
Oce said turnover at its engineering systems division had grown by 13 percent to 740 million guilders in the six months to May 31, 1997.
This rise was the balance of a four percent increase because of takeovers, an eight percent exchange rates effect and a one percent organic growth.
The office systems division posted first-half turnover of 1.09 billion guilders, up 19 percent from the year-ago period.
In this division, previous takeovers raised sales by nine percent, exchange rate effects by seven percent and organic growth totalled three percent.
Oce said deliveries of its new Oce 3165 digital high volume network copier and printer had come on stream well in the second quarter of the current year.
This new product made a clear contribution to net profits, which is expected to show a further increase in the second quarter of 1996/97, the company said.

Oce's printing systems division's first-half turnover soared to 685 million guilders from 218 million. This was mainly caused by the previous takeover of SNI Printing, which was included in last year's first-half figures for only two months.
